messages:
maria: quick sanity sweep of model-x on staging with int4 / int8 / fp8 profiles. ran our default promptset (n=1200). high-level summary:
- int8: latency -25%, avg token time ~1.8ms, QA F1 ~-0.6 pts vs fp16
- int4: latency -40%, QA F1 ~-3.2 pts, visible regressions on long-turn Qs (context >256)
- fp8: perf similar to int8 but observed occasional NaN in matmul kernel at batch=8 on A100S

sam: can you paste the exact bench command + build hash? which kernel build did you use?

maria: bench command I ran:
```bash
./bench --model model-x --quant=int4 --batch=4 --prompts=prompts.tar.gz --run-id=cqrs-1934 --seed=42
# build: runtime-2026-03-10-gc1a2b
```

jin: do you have per-prompt failure examples? a few ids would help triage. :eyes: 

maria: uploaded small diff. failing example prompt id 278: answer gets truncated then repeats token stream (hallucination). also per-prompt perplexity is much higher for sequences >512. artifact: s3://redwood-staging/cqrs/1934/artifacts/278_diff.txt

leo: about the fp8 NaN — can you capture kernel trace / env? try `export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=0` (or runtime equivalent) and re-run with `--trace-kernels` so we get the offending kernel launch args

maria: re-ran with tracing, log shows `kernel_launch: nan detected in matmul` at step 125. repro rate ~1/400 runs (so rare). attached short log snippet.

sam: quick suggestion: for int4 we used symmetric quantization by default. try an asymmetric quant profile (per-channel) to see if it recovers long-turn fidelity. can you try int4-asym?

jin: I'll spin up a canary job comparing int4-symm vs int4-asym (small 200 prompt run) and post diffs. ETA ~90m.

ops-bot: job cqrs-int4-asym-1934 started on rtx-pool (job id 87421) :rocket:

maria: thanks. also thinking we should gate int4 rollout: don't route traffic with seq_len > 256 to int4 until we validate. propose rollout config: `max_seq=256` for int4 variant.

leo: +1 on gating. can we add a console alert for long-turn F1 drop >1.5 pts so we catch regressions early? would be helpful for automated rollouts.

sam: I'll open a quick PR to add the gating config + metric aggregation for the console. pinging reviewers when draft is ready.

jin: canary results: int4-asym reduces QA F1 drop to ~-1.5 pts (vs -3.2 for int4-symm), latency ~= int4-symm. fp8 NaN still reproduces at batch=8 on A100S but not on V100 — seems hardware/kernel-layout related.

maria: next steps: (1) sam opens PR for gating + console metric; (2) jin files kernel bug with attached HW traces and A100 logs (link to ticket internal); (3) I'll run extended sweep overnight with int4-asym + gating and post summary tomorrow AM.

leo: sounds good. @sam @jin @maria please also add short notes to the quant-ops board so PMs see the risk. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: job cqrs-sweep-1934 completed — artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/cqrs/1934/summary.json
